summary: Train parliamentary teams to apply AI responsibly across legislative workflows. Build governance tools, lesson plans, and implementation roadmaps. Enrol today.
lede: AI-enabled parliamentary work training prepares professionals to train staff in responsible AI use across parliamentary workflows. Participants practice assessing use cases and readiness, designing prompts and human-review controls, and creating facilitator materials and learning evaluations. The NIST AI Risk Management Framework provides a practical organizing reference, while ISO/IEC 42001 and ISO/IEC 23894 are introduced as governance and risk references, not implementation certification.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who train, supervise, govern, or support AI-enabled parliamentary work and need to convert emerging technology practices into repeatable learning interventions. It suits intermediate to advanced practitioners who can relate AI use to legislative workflows, committee services, parliamentary administration, and institutional accountability.
prerequisites: You should have working experience in parliamentary administration, legislative research, committee services, records management, ICT, governance, or professional training. No coding or programming is required. You should be comfortable reviewing documents, facilitating workplace learning, and discussing confidentiality, accountability, and procedural accuracy. Advanced AI topics receive conceptual awareness and operational application treatment, while selected prompt design, assessment, and facilitation activities receive hands-on practice.
topics: Legal risk for AI, data and digital services
